rules.requirement: Owner must hold a valid short-term residential occupancy license for the dwelling unit.
rules.quote: A license is required for all short-term residential occupancy.

rules.requirement: Owner may not hold more than one license at a time.
rules.quote: A host may only hold one license at a time.

rules.requirement: Owner may not operate more than one dwelling unit as a short-term rental in the city at a time.
rules.quote: A host may not operate more than one dwelling unit for short-term residential occupancy at a time within the City of San Diego.

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a Tier One License to rent for an aggregate of 20 days or less per calendar year.
rules.quote:
A Tier One License is required for home share or whole home short-
term residential occupancy for an aggregate total of 20 days or less per
calendar year.

rules.requirement: Owner must use the dwelling unit as the owner's primary residence for a Tier One home share.
rules.quote:
Home share with a Tier One License is only allowed in the host’s
primary residence.

rules.requirement: Owner may not obtain more than one Tier One License for a dwelling unit per calendar year.
rules.quote:
Only one Tier One License may be issued for a dwelling unit per
calendar year.

rules.requirement: Owner must renew the license before it expires two years after issuance.
rules.quote:
A Tier One License shall expire two years from the date of issuance
and may be renewed in accordance with Municipal Code section
510.0106(d).

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a Tier Two License to home share more than 20 days per calendar year.
rules.quote:
A Tier Two License is required for home share short-term residential
occupancy for an aggregate total of more than 20 days per calendar
year.

rules.requirement: Owner must use the dwelling unit as the owner's primary residence for a Tier Two home share.
rules.quote:
Home share with a Tier Two License is only allowed in the host’s
primary residence.

rules.requirement: Owner must occupy the primary residence at least 275 days of the calendar year it is rented as a home share.
rules.quote:
The host shall occupy the host’s primary residence for no less than
275 days of the calendar year in which the primary residence is rented
as a home share.

rules.requirement: Owner must occupy the residence at least 75 percent of the days owned or rented if not held for the full preceding calendar year.
rules.quote:
If the host has not rented or owned the dwelling unit
for the full preceding calendar year, the host shall occupy the host’s
primary residence for no less than 75 percent of the days the host has
owned or rented the dwelling unit.

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a Tier Three License for whole home rental outside Mission Beach for more than 20 days per calendar year.
rules.quote:
A Tier Three License is required for whole home short-term
residential occupancy outside the Mission Beach Community
Planning Area as described in section 510.0104(e) for an aggregate
total of more than 20 days per calendar year.

rules.requirement: Owner must require a minimum stay of two consecutive nights by the same guest under a Tier Three License.
rules.quote: A two consecutive night minimum stay by the same guest is required.

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a Tier Four License for whole home rental within Mission Beach for more than 20 days per calendar year.
rules.quote:
A Tier Four License is required for whole home short-term residential
occupancy within the Mission Beach Community Planning Area
(depicted on the Map on file in the office of the City Clerk as
Document No. OO-21305) for an aggregate total of more than 20 days
per calendar year.

rules.requirement: Owner must require a minimum stay of two consecutive nights by the same guest under a Tier Four License.
rules.quote: A two consecutive night minimum stay by the same guest is required.

rules.requirement: Owner must be the host in order to apply for a license.
rules.quote: Only a host may apply for a license.

rules.requirement: Owner must provide a Transient Occupancy Tax Certificate number or proof of concurrent application with the license application.
rules.quote:
A Transient Occupancy Tax Certificate number for the dwelling unit
or proof of concurrent application for a Transient Occupancy Tax
Certificate for the dwelling unit.

rules.requirement: Owner must submit proof of payment of the Rental Unit Business Tax with the license application, if applicable.
rules.quote: Proof of payment of the Rental Unit Business Tax, if applicable.

rules.requirement: Owner must submit proof that the dwelling unit is the owner's primary residence when applying to home share.
rules.quote:
For an application for a license to home share, proof that the dwelling
unit is the host’s primary residence.

rules.requirement: Owner may not be issued more than one short-term rental license in the city at a time.
rules.quote:
A host may be issued only one license for short-term residential occupancy at
a time within the City of San Diego.

rules.requirement: Owner must pay the required license fees before a license is issued.
rules.quote:
A Tier Three License or a Tier Four License shall only be issued when
the required fees have been paid.

rules.requirement: Owner must timely pay the renewal fee, have complied with the ordinance, report any changes to the prior application, and submit required records to renew a license.
rules.quote:
(A) timely pays the renewal fee;
(B) has complied with the provisions of this Division during the
term of the current license;
(C) provides information concerning any changes to the previous
application for or renewal of the license; and
(D) submits the records described in Municipal Code section
510.0107, unless the host lists exclusively on a hosting
platform that has an agreement with the City that includes a
provision for pass-through registration for license applicants.

rules.requirement: Owner may not transfer or assign a license or license application.
rules.quote:
Licenses are not transferrable. The City shall not accept any request to transfer
or assign ownership or location of any license or license application.

rules.requirement: Owner must maintain and use the dwelling unit at all times for residential occupancy only.
rules.quote: maintain and use the dwelling unit at all times for residential occupancy only;

rules.requirement: Owner must be present on the premises during a Tier Two home share.
rules.quote:
for Tier Two Licenses, home share while present on the premises in
accordance with section 510.0104(c)(3);

rules.requirement: Owner must use a Tier Three or Tier Four license at least 90 days each year and submit quarterly utilization reports to the city.
rules.quote:
for Tier Three Licenses and Tier Four Licenses, use the license a minimum of
90 days each year during the term of the license and submit quarterly reports
to the City Manager containing the number of days the dwelling unit, or any
portion thereof, was used for short-term residential occupancy to demonstrate
utilization;

rules.requirement: Owner may not allow the short-term rental to create a public nuisance.
rules.quote: not allow the short-term residential occupancy to create a public nuisance;

rules.requirement: Owner must comply with the city's transient occupancy tax provisions.
rules.quote: comply with Chapter 3, Article 5, Division 1 of the Municipal Code;

rules.requirement: Owner must provide proof of payment of the Rental Unit Business Tax upon city request, if applicable.
rules.quote:
provide proof of payment of the Rental Unit Business Tax to the City upon
request, if applicable;

rules.requirement: Owner must give all guests a Good Neighbor Policy notice covering neighborhood conduct, occupancy limits, parking, trash, noise limits, vacating, and police response costs.
rules.quote:
provide a Good Neighbor Policy notice, on a form acceptable to the City
Manager, to all guests that advises, at a minimum, the following:

rules.requirement: Owner must ensure the dwelling unit complies with current California Fire Code regulations.
Owner may not post signs on the premises promoting a business.
rules.quote: that signs on the premises promoting a business are not allowed;

rules.requirement: Owner must designate a local contact who responds to complaints in person or by phone within one hour and takes action to resolve them.
rules.quote:
designate a local contact who shall be responsible for actively discouraging
and preventing any nuisance activity at the premises, pursuant to Chapter 5 of
the Municipal Code. The host or designated local contact shall respond to a
complainant in person or by telephone within one hour for all reported
complaints and shall take action to resolve the matter;

rules.requirement: Owner must post an exterior notice visible from the public right-of-way showing the Transient Occupancy Tax Certificate number, license number, and contact information, and maintain it in good condition.
rules.quote:
post a notice on the exterior of the dwelling unit in a location visible to the
public from the sidewalk or public right-of-way, whichever is closer, that
includes the Transient Occupancy Tax Certificate number, license number,
contact information and telephone number for the host or the designated local
contact and for the City of San Diego Code Enforcement Division. The host
shall maintain the notice in good condition while the dwelling unit is operated
for short-term residential occupancy.

rules.requirement: Owner must make the posted notice 8.5 by 11 inches in all capital black bold font of at least 20 points.
rules.quote: The notice shall be 8.5 inches by 11 inches.

rules.requirement: Owner must include the Transient Occupancy Tax Certificate number and license number on all advertisements.
rules.quote:
include the Transient Occupancy Tax Certificate number and license number
on all advertisements; and

rules.requirement: Owner must post human trafficking reporting guidance inside the unit and educate employees or contractors about identifying and reporting human trafficking.
rules.quote:
post, in a conspicuous location within the dwelling unit, guidance for guests to
report human trafficking based on information provided by the City Manager
and educate employees or contractors of the host who may interact with
guests about identifying and reporting human trafficking.

rules.requirement: Owner must keep records of each rental transaction for four years, including address, dates and nights, Good Neighbor notice, gross receipts and tax numbers.
rules.quote:
A host shall maintain the following information for each short-term
residential occupancy transaction for a period of four years from the date of
the transaction:

rules.requirement: Owner must complete a human trafficking awareness course before the initial listing and keep proof while licensed.
rules.quote:
For as long as a host holds a license, a host shall maintain proof of completing
a human trafficking awareness course prior to the initial listing of the dwelling
unit for short-term residential occupancy.

rules.requirement: Owner must deliver the required transaction records to the city upon request.
rules.quote:
Subject to applicable law, a host shall deliver information provided in
Municipal Code section 510.0108(a) to the City Manager upon request.
